body:
Setting: My home.
Background: 18 yo, 140 lb.  I have used LSA (MG and HBWR), DXM, Acacia Confusa (multiple times), 20x Salvia (multiple times), and weak Amanita Muscaria.
Goal: I wanted to try DMT with 1 seed of Datura Stramonium.
Ingredients:  Yellow Banisteriopsis Caapi vine, 1 seed of Datura Stramonium, and powdered Acacia Confusa Bark.
PREPARATION
I boiled 2 tbsp. of B. Caapi bark in 1 C of water for 3 minutes, removed from heat, and steeped for 10 minutes.  I re-boiled the same Caapi two more times for a total of 3 C of tea (the last boil produced a much lighter brew than the first two, which were a solid amber).  I then measured 7g of A. Confusa, encapsulated 2g, and mixed the other 5g into some peanut butter.  I fasted for about four hours before the trip (ate only breakfast and a small lunch).
EFFECTS
4:00 pm Drank 1 C B. Caapi.
4:45 pm Drank 2 C B. Caapi and ate 1 seed of Datura Stramonium. (Note that I tried 1 seed of Datura Stramonium the day before, so I could have had the chemicals of 2 seeds in my system at the time of the trip).
5:15 pm Ate 7g A. Confusa.
Approximately 30 mins later the trip began.  I felt like I was somewhere other than my body the whole time except when I opened my eyes.  I noticed that again, time was irrelevant.  Whenever I tried to remember what had just happened I was unable to because each successive vision replaced the previous.
The visions were notably more realistic and engulfing than those produced by just DMT and B. Caapi.  The tactile hallucinations were also markedly different than those produced by only DMT.  They were much less euphoric, and more closely related to the prickly feeling brought about by a low dose of Salvia.  I also noticed that I was much more easily scared by the visions produced with the addition of Datura as opposed to those produced by DMT alone.  I often found myself jumping as an insanely realistic vision jumped at me.
The visions were also closely similar to Salvia.  I remember visions where everything was fuzzy because of bugs on the wall or something during Salvia, and this happened with this combination of DMT too.  The main thing I remember from this trip is some guy (who was very big and didnt look like a real person) ran at me in this dungeon and attacked me with his manual meat tenderizer (but it was much larger than a normal manual meat tenderizerit was probably as tall as me.  It reminded me of something off God of War video game covers).
I also remember being put in a tub and inspected by aliens.  This memory just came to me, but its pretty weird that I experienced this for the first time through the use of Datura (because IV DMT often produced this vision, according to Dr. Strassman).  Throughout the trip I was twitching like I was having a seizure, but I was able to control it with careful, difficult concentration.
Throughout the trip I was twitching like I was having a seizure, but I was able to control it with careful, difficult concentration.
I was also able to hold a vision in my mind if I concentrated hard enough.
As the trip was winding down I painstakingly rolled into my bed.  I was unable to sleep at first, but eventually sleep came.  I awoke some time later tripping just as hard as before.  At first I thought it was just a dream, but when I opened my eyes it certainly wasnt.  The covers were making weird shapes in my bed, I was sinking deep into the bed, and I had no sense of up or down.  It is also worth noting that I felt like any movement would cause me to throw up.  Thankfully, since misery loves company, I was sharing this experience with the other people in my bed (there was no one in the bed with me.  I was imagining them).
Eventually I got up and ran to the bathroom to throw up.  EVERYTHING was distorted, and I could barely move.  I was unable to throw up, so I went back to bed.  Walking had helped me feel a little better, so I thought watching some TV might help even more.  I started with Bad Boys.  After it was over I saw 21 Jump Street was on, so I watched that.  I was constantly improving, so I decided I would eat the toast and orange I made earlier.  After finishing this food I was coming up on another trip (I believe butter helps facilitate a trip, as it definitely has helped my DMT trips come up more quickly).
I lay down into the couch and watched the room move, morph, and change.  I was in a trance.  I was twitching constantly.  Even the characters on TV were moving in a choppy, non-lifelike manner.  Everything was again distorted, but it was quite an enjoyable feeling in a weird way.  On one hand I didnt know how long this would last and I questioned if I had hurt myself.  On the other hand, the body high was fairly enjoyable, and the visuals were amazing.  Later I noticed that my eyes were very dry. (Along withother mucous membranes).
The next morning I woke up tired, but experienced no after-effects. I will definitely try this combination again in the future, but Im not sure that Ill do it any time soonIt was very intense, and Im a busy person any way.
